hook: A cobalt and light catalyst joins aldehydes, amines and alkynes into single-handed allylic amines.
summary: Combining visible-light photoredox with a cobalt catalyst and a new chiral phosphoramidite ligand, the authors couple three simple starting materials in one step with high enantioselectivity. They show late-stage modification of bioactive molecules and a short synthesis of prasugrel. Mechanism claims rest on computation and mechanistic studies of this catalyst system.
title: Enantioselective Three-Component Reductive Coupling of Aldehydes, Amines, and Alkynes via Ligand-Enabled Cobalt/Photoredox Dual Catalysis for Modular Synthesis of Allylic Amines
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
